text: Case open!
Hey! That's not fair! My lamington is gone!
Pip saw who took it.
Today's case: a witness who needs better words.
Pip wrote it down. It was big. It was loud.
Big and loud are dull words. They fit lots of things.
A synonym means nearly the same thing.
It's like a sausage sizzle.
Hungry and starving are synonyms. Starving is more exact.
Big and loud? It was the kookaburra!
Hmm. The cockatoo is big and loud too.
Let's not guess. Let's test.
Can you point to the two big birds?
Pip swapped loud for screeching. Which bird screeches?
A. The kookaburra.
B. The cockatoo.
Pause and think.
Swap a dull word for a more exact synonym.
Kookaburras don't screech. They laugh.
Cockatoos screech. Loud and sharp.
It's B! The cockatoo.
Oh! I picked too fast!
Let's check another way. Look closely.
Coconut crumbs on the cockatoo's beak!
Both clues point to the cockatoo!
Case solved!
Listen! The kookaburra is laughing!
It's glad we didn't blame it!
Remember. Swap a dull word for a more exact synonym.
